Steiner formula gives the asserted objective for all t>=0. Explicit differentiation yields p prime negative, U=-a prime/p prime, U prime=H/(6H0^2). The included SymPy program reconstructs H from displayed definitions, checks its complete degree-20 Maclaurin coefficient list, the Fourier coefficient norms and a global Taylor remainder bound; Q20>(2/5)beta^6 and remainder<beta^6/5000 prove U prime strictly positive for every beta in (0,pi/6]. Derivative endpoint limits give exactly 1/3 and (3+2sqrt(3)-2pi)/(2pi-6). Sign analysis establishes every optimizer and the nonattained boundary. No finite sampling is used as a continuous proof. The classification produces two sharp analytic transition constants, a unique genuinely curved interior optimizer on a nonempty parameter interval, global uniqueness/nonattainment distinctions, and a fully verifiable nontrivial analytic curvature inequality.
